name: lokdarpan
description: LokDarpan is a MERN stack-based video hosting and streaming platform. It allows users to upload, share, and stream videos with a modern, interactive interface for both creators and viewers

scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker,rec -c blue,magenta,yellow "node Server.js" "node workers/transcodeEncode.worker.js" "node workers/recStats.worker.js"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,rec -c blue,magenta,yellow "nodemon Server.js" "node workers/transcodeEncode.worker.js" "node workers/recStats.worker.js"
scripts.e2e:reset: docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v && docker compose -f e2e/docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build

author: RajBhoyar729
